as_told.title: C-van briefing on the gray project inside the black project

plain: Between 1990 and 1993, a secret effort called the gray project was hidden inside a regular secret, or black, project, so that only a few people in the black project knew the gray one existed, like the layers of an onion. Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the National Security Agency, the US spy agency for intercepted signals, hired him to communicate with aliens, tells this to Jesse Michels. He says an officer named Captain White explained the layering to him, telling him others would cover the cover work but "I'm going to talk to you about the gray project." The story places the briefing at agency headquarters in Maryland, while Sherman in one telling puts it in a communications van at an overseas post. If true, it would show how a programme could stay hidden even from people working right beside it.
